title: Kodiak Sciences Completes Enrollment in First Pivotal Cohort in the Phase 3 PEAK Trial of KSI-101 for Macular Edema Secondary to Inflammation and Reaffirms Topline Clinical Data Release Remains on Track for December 2026
summary: Kodiak Sciences Inc. (Nasdaq: KOD) today announced that it has completed enrollment of the first 300-patient cohort in its PEAK trial, supporting Pivotal Analysis 1 of the KSI-101 Phase 3 program in macular edema secondary to inflammation ("MESI"). Kodiak also reaffirmed its plan to release the topline data from Pivotal Analysis 1 in December 2026.
